dataset_name: Tata Motors FY25 Financial RAG Benchmark — Hard Set
purpose: 128-question challenging benchmark for retrieval, answer correctness, citation grounding, abstention and latency evaluation.

source.title: Tata Motors Limited, 80th Integrated Annual Report 2024–25
source.scope: Financial Highlights table on printed page 150; selected key performance highlights on printed page 18 for source background. Units on page 150 are ₹ crore.
source.source_note: Keep standalone and consolidated scopes distinct. Preserve negative values shown in parentheses. Derived questions require calculation from the cited table values. The annual report PDF must be ingested as the actual corpus.

evaluation_notes: This is a challenging benchmark with direct table lookups and multi-step calculations.
Relevant chunk IDs are intentionally empty and must be mapped against the exact chunks produced by the current FinVis ingestion pipeline. Never fabricate chunk IDs.
The reference answers for derived questions are calculated from the cited values; the calculation is stored per question.
Unanswerable items target facts not reported in the source report; verify against the complete PDF before scoring abstention.
Score retrieval only on answerable items. Score abstention accuracy on the 24 unanswerable items. Report counts and denominators alongside percentages.
Do not tune the system to these reference answers or hardcode question IDs.
